method: manual source review via the live EURES public JSON API (https://europa.eu/eures/api/jv-searchengine/public/jv/id/{source_id}): each posting fetched live from a europa.eu origin page, stored title compared against the live title, and the live body read for role confirmation before translation. Not model output. 14 of 18 candidates in this window returned HTTP 200 with exact title matches and were filled. Four postings returned HTTP 404 (dead postings) and were skipped without a fill: 274d40c57492d433 (DE, Lagerhelfer gesucht (m/w/d) – Top-Verdienst durch Top-Leistung (Lager- und Transportarbeiter/in)); 27bf1c500c052595 (DE, Lagermitarbeiter (m/w/d) Tagschicht (Lager- und Transportarbeiter/in)); 28160cc61190e87e (HR, POMOĆNI/A SKLADIŠTAR/KA); 2882b09195320557 (BE, Orderpicker nachtploeg) - the dead-link sweep handles them. The five previously held postings (00cfb0e9af186fce, 0c10c84afe31213a, 0dad6f50ad84127b, 108f2edcfb6b67d8, 112d65cfb3e268bf) were skipped and remain held. No candidate in this window carried the legacy partial-AR marker, so no overwrite:true fills were needed.
